topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Workforce use rules (POL-02 Part C) and sanctions (A.4) approved 2026-09-15
gap: No signed acknowledgments yet
remediation: Collect signed acknowledgments from all 7 staff

control_description: No board (private LLC). The Owner receives a monthly security report and a yearly program report (POL-02 A.10)
gap: Oversight starts in October; no record yet
remediation: Hold and keep notes of the monthly security meeting

control_description: Information Security Lead and Compliance Coordinator designated in writing; roles in POL-02 section 3; MDR duties in its contract
Background checks before hire; yearly awareness module
gap: No role-based training for the 5 technical staff
remediation: 2-hour administrator training (RMM script safety, caller verification, bank notice duty)

control_description: Every risk and POA&M item has a named owner; sanctions rule in POL-02 A.4
gap: Accountability not yet reviewed in practice
remediation: Review POA&M owners' progress at the monthly meeting

control_description: Hardware spreadsheet only
gap: No inventory of SaaS, cloud resources, or where bank customer information sits; management-plane logs not collected
remediation: System and data inventory (POL-04 4.4); management-plane logs to the MDR (POAM-009)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies in the PSA knowledge base; yearly training; 1-hour reporting rule (POL-03 4.2)
gap: Reporting rule not yet trained; 3 of 5 staff unsure whom to call after hours (P07)
remediation: Reporting card and training (POAM-011)

control_description: MSA sets 72-hour incident notice; maintenance notices by mailing list; bank notice steps in P08
gap: No valid designated contacts at either bank; Bank B missing from maintenance notices
remediation: Bank service register and designated contacts (POAM-011); maintenance notices to banks (G-006)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service commitments defined in the MSA (99.9% availability, 72-hour incident notice) and recovery objectives in the BIA
First risk assessment with NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1, covering all systems and key vendors
Insider misuse of the RMM tool (R-001) and social engineering of the support desk (R-005) are in the risk register
gap: No structured assessment of fraud or misuse (for example a technician pushing scripts for gain, or fake customer requests)
remediation: Add misuse and fraud scenarios to the July 2027 risk assessment

control_description: None
gap: Changes to the platform and tools are not assessed for risk before they happen
remediation: Change log with risk and rollback fields (R-015)

control_description: Independent control assessment of 13 controls, 2026-08-17 to 2026-08-19; yearly under POL-02 A.6
Weaknesses tracked in the POA&M; progress reported monthly to the Owner
gap: Monthly reporting starts in October
remediation: First monthly POA&M report to the Owner

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: SSP documents 46 controls with owners and status
gap: 36 of 46 controls not fully implemented (28 partially implemented, 8 planned)
remediation: POA&M and P01 treatment plans

control_description: Technology controls set at the vendor platforms and DC-1 devices
gap: Configuration of the RMM tool, hypervisor manager, and cloud tenant leaves the main gaps (P04 section 4)
remediation: POAM-001 to POAM-006

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: POL-02, POL-03, and POL-04 approved 2026-09-15, effective 2026-10-01
gap: Supporting checklists (onboarding, termination, change, restore test) not yet written
remediation: Write the four checklists

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Named identity provider accounts with MFA; VPN with MFA to the management network
evidence: Identity provider and VPN settings; P07 results
gap: Shared RMM and hypervisor administrator accounts; no MFA at the hypervisor and BMC layer; consoles open to any address (P07)
remediation: POAM-001, POAM-002, POAM-005

control_description: Accounts created on an email request
gap: No recorded approval, account types, or roles
remediation: Onboarding checklist with approval (POAM-001)

control_description: Support Engineers have no cluster or cloud administrator rights
gap: Former employee's access stayed for months; over-privileged portal service account; Owner's standing administrator rights; open vault
remediation: POAM-003, POAM-013

control_description: DC-1 badge, biometric, and camera controls, locked racks (inherited from the colocation provider)
evidence: Colocation SOC 2 Type 2 report (reviewed 2026-08-26); DC-1 walkthrough
gap: The company's complementary controls were not run: the authorized-person list and cage access reports were not reviewed
remediation: Quarterly access list review and monthly cage report review (POL-02 B.9)

control_description: Retired hosts wiped with the vendor tool
gap: No wipe records; failed drives returned with readable data
remediation: Keep-the-drive option; certified destruction records (POL-04 4.8)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Firewall pair separates customer networks; management network only through the VPN with MFA; upstream DDoS filtering
evidence: Firewall rule export; colocation service order
gap: RMM and cloud consoles reachable from any address; BMCs on the shared management VLAN
remediation: POAM-005; BMC jump host (POAM-002)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher on the portal, API, RMM agents, and backup copy; VPN for administration

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all 9 laptops with 24x7 MDR response

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Laptops patch automatically; firewalls quarterly
evidence: Host version report; BMC firmware list
gap: No vulnerability scanning; hosts two minor releases behind; BMC firmware from 2022
remediation: Monthly authenticated scans and patch time limits (R-006)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MDR monitors laptops, identity provider, and firewalls
evidence: MDR data source list; P07 SI-4 results
gap: Management plane not monitored; misuse of the RMM tool raised no alert in testing
remediation: POAM-009, POAM-010

control_description: MDR analysts and AI triage evaluate events 24x7
gap: Most alerts auto-closed by the AI with no company review
remediation: Monthly auto-close sample and no auto-close for privileged and tooling alerts (P10 conditions)

control_description: POL-03 and the P08 runbook approved 2026-09-15
gap: Not tested; two past incidents handled without records
remediation: Tabletop with the MDR and a bank scenario (POAM-011)

control_description: Customer restores done on request
gap: No contingency plan or recovery runbook; only one person has rebuilt the cluster
remediation: Contingency plan and recovery runbook (POAM-007; R-018)

control_description: Changes announced in team chat
gap: No change records, approval, testing, or rollback plan
remediation: Change log in the PSA with second-engineer approval (R-015)

control_description: Cyber insurance with a breach hotline; BIA approved
gap: Single site; no plan for a DC-1 loss
remediation: Degraded-mode recovery into the cloud tenant (R-009)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Contracts on file for all vendors; colocation SOC 2 report reviewed 2026-08-26
gap: RMM and MDR never reviewed; RMM contract lacks incident notice; MDR telemetry-use clause
remediation: POAM-012

control_description: Cluster sized to run with one host down; hypervisor manager tracks CPU, memory, and storage use; the Lead Systems Engineer checks capacity monthly before taking new orders
evidence: Monthly capacity check (June and July 2026 records)

control_description: Colocation power, cooling, and fire protection (inherited); nightly backups for add-on VMs with a 30-day cloud copy
evidence: Colocation SOC 2 report; backup job report
gap: Backup copy not immutable and in the portal's account; no copy of DNS zones; no second site

control_description: None
gap: Restores never tested and recorded; no recovery exercise
remediation: Quarterly restore tests; site-loss exercise (POAM-007)
